程安是喝多了，但他并没有完全的醉倒。他一点一点的亲吻着秦书简的唇，见她不曾躲闪，才缓缓抱紧了她。她没有拒绝，应当是明白他的心意的。闯入她的世界的那一刻，他握紧了她的手指，贴在她的耳边，轻轻的说了句，“我喜欢你。”我喜欢你，喜欢你很久很久了。许是从第一眼，许是从第一次听到你的名字，许是细水长流，日久生情。也许是冥冥中注定，……一遇见，就是一眼万年。…第二天早上，秦书简醒来的时候，程安还在睡着。她呆呆的盯着陌生的天花板看了许久，才缓缓想起来，昨天晚上究竟发生了什么事。她就算是再傻再笨，也知道这一晚代表着什么。从一上高中开始，她就莫名其妙的被他盯上，然后被他指挥着要么帮他抄作业，要么帮他跑腿买饮料，给他拎书包，他生病的时候还要让她给他一口一口的喂饭，最惨的是他不高兴了还要罚她抄情书，……三年，她整整被他给压榨了三年。以至于最开始老有人私底下暗戳戳的说程安看上了她，到最后她被他给压榨的，大家都戏称她是程安的“贴身小丫鬟”。而现在，她还要被迫成为一个“陪睡小丫鬟”？秦书简哆嗦了下，想想都觉得好可怕。就算……昨天在电影院里，他对着别人说了他就是她男人，可那也只是替她解围罢了。他从未说过喜欢她。她也不是真的不懂事。她是智商不高，甚至还有点蠢笨，但是她明白，她并不愿意这样子留在他身边。一个念头，突然间在她心头缓缓成型。秦书简轻吸了一口气，从未想过如此多问题的她，一下子想了这么多乱七八糟的，让她有点脑仁疼。她趁着程安没睡醒，悄悄的穿上衣服，去洗手间轻手轻脚的收拾了一下自己。从洗手间里出来，她看程安还没醒，松了口气，转过身，小心翼翼的朝着卧室门口走去。结果刚走了没两步，一只胳膊就从后面拦住了她的腰。程安弯着身，下巴压在她的肩膀上，鼻尖在她脖子上轻轻的蹭了蹭，大约是刚睡醒，声音里带着几分懒散，“去哪儿？嗯？”秦书简下意识的绷紧了身体。去哪儿？？当然是跑啊！可是她咬了咬唇，不敢说。程安没等到她的回答，吃吃笑了一声，然后将她的身体转过来，抱住了她的腰，稍稍一用力，将人给扛在了肩上。身体突然腾空的秦书简吓了一跳，哆嗦着声音：“你你你……你干嘛？”程安将她重新丢回到床上，塞到被子里。秦书简惊恐的看着缓缓向她靠近的少年，他带着倦意的眼睛半眯着，凌乱的发丝砸在眼角，眼尾不知是没睡好还是怎的，残留着一抹红，活像只勾人的妖精。她呼吸渐渐急促，若是此时有人问她，狐狸精索命是什么样的，她一定毫不犹豫的说，程安现在这样的。她感觉到身边的位置陷了下去，然后紧张地闭上了眼睛。程安将她捞到怀里，从背后圈住了她的腰，下巴搁在她颈间蹭了蹭，“小笨蛋，再睡会儿。”

Cheng An drank too much, but he was not completely drunk. He kissed Qin Shujian's lips bit by bit. Seeing that she didn't dodge, he slowly hugged her tightly. She didn't refuse, so she should have understood what he meant. The moment he broke into her world, he held her finger tightly, put it against her ear, and said softly, "I like you." I like you, and have liked you for a long, long time. Maybe it’s from the first sight, maybe it’s the first time I hear your name, maybe it’s the slow flow of water, and the love grows over time. Maybe it was destined,... As soon as they met, they were in love with each other for thousands of years. ...The next morning, when Qin Shujian woke up, Cheng An was still asleep. She stared blankly at the unfamiliar ceiling for a long time before slowly remembering what happened last night. No matter how stupid or stupid she is, she still knows what this night represents. Ever since she entered high school, she had been inexplicably targeted by him, and was ordered by him to either copy his homework, run errands to buy drinks for him, or carry his school bag. When he was sick, he had to ask her to feed him bite by bite. The worst thing was that he would punish her to write love letters when he was unhappy... She was exploited by him for three years. So much so that at first there were always people secretly saying that Cheng An was attracted to her, but in the end she was exploited by him, and everyone jokingly called her Cheng An's "personal maid". And now, she is forced to become a "little maid who sleeps with her"? Qin Shujian shivered, and it felt so scary just thinking about it. Even if... yesterday in the cinema, he told others that he was her man, but that was just to save her. He never said he liked her. She's not really ignorant. She has a low IQ and is even a little stupid, but she understands that she doesn't want to stay with him like this. An idea suddenly took shape in her mind. Qin Shujian took a deep breath. She had never thought about so many problems before, and thinking about so many messy things all at once gave her a headache. She put on her clothes quietly while Cheng An didn't wake up, and went to the bathroom to clean herself up gently. When she came out of the bathroom, she saw that Cheng An was still awake. She breathed a sigh of relief, turned around, and walked cautiously towards the bedroom door. As a result, after taking only two steps, an arm blocked her waist from behind. Cheng An bent over, his chin pressed on her shoulder, and the tip of his nose gently rubbed her neck. He must have just woken up, and his voice was a bit lazy, "Where are you going? Huh?" Qin Shujian subconsciously tensed up. Where to go? ? Of course, run! But she bit her lip and didn't dare to say anything. Cheng An didn't wait for her answer, chuckled, then turned her body around, hugged her waist, and put her on his shoulders with a little force. Qin Shujian was startled when her body suddenly became airborne, and she said with a trembling voice: "You, you, you... what are you doing?" Cheng An threw her back on the bed and stuffed her into the quilt. Qin Shujian looked at the young man who was slowly approaching her in horror. His tired eyes were half-closed, his messy hair stuck in the corners of his eyes, and there was a trace of red at the end of his eyes, whether it was because he had not slept well or something, like a seductive fairy. Her breathing gradually became rapid. If someone asked her at this time what it was like for a vixen to seek her life, she would definitely say without hesitation that Cheng An was like this. She felt the area around her sink, and she closed her eyes nervously. Cheng An lifted her into his arms, hugged her waist from behind, put his chin on her neck and rubbed her, "You little fool, sleep a little longer."
